name: website_https
description: An Ansible playbook that provisions an Ubuntu Apache HTTPS site, including packages, self-signed TLS certificates, virtual host configuration, site and SSL enablement, and service management.

name: poodle_fix
description: An Ansible playbook that hardens Apache SSL configuration by restricting protocols to TLS 1.2 and restarting affected services.

name: website_https_verification
description: A Chef InSpec verification profile for validating HTTPS availability, expected site content, disabled SSLv3, and enabled TLS 1.2.

name: ssh_root_login_control
description: A Chef InSpec compliance control that verifies SSH root login is disabled and includes related OpenSSH and RHEL 8 STIG metadata.

name: chef_automate_deployment
description: A bootstrap deployment script that configures host and kernel settings, deploys Chef Automate with Chef Infra Server, and creates a Chef user and organization with PEM credentials.

name: chef_server_deployment
description: A bootstrap deployment script for standalone Chef Infra Server that configures the host, creates a Chef user and organization, and generates PEM credentials.
